biography.plain_text: Alexander Mazanov is a Russian banker and former majority owner of Moscow's Transportny Bank. A graduate of the Moscow State Institute of International Relations, he previously headed Evrazbank. He became Transportny's controlling shareholder in 2011; the bank lost its licence in 2015 after its capital was exhausted by poor-quality assets.

confidence.reason: Dated banking biography, majority-ownership reporting and the regulator's formal notice support these historical facts; no present ownership or personal culpability is asserted.

long_biography.plain_text:
Foreign-currency banking shaped Alexander Mazanov's early career. He worked in the Russian central bank's foreign-operations department, then became chief economist in the Interstate Bank's finance division. At the Moscow Bank for Reconstruction and Development, he progressed from heading the currency department to leading its currency and finance directorate.

His business interests later extended to the Netherlands. In 2014 he bought the bankrupt ICON Yachts shipyard in Harlingen, where construction resumed alongside refits and conversions. During the following years the yard expanded its workforce and planned additional docking capacity. A majority stake in the shipyard passed to Swiss businessman Micca Ferrero in 2021.

confidence.reason: Contemporary career directory supports the formative banking roles. Independent trade reporting supports the bankruptcy acquisition, subsequent yard activity and 2021 majority change without attributing corporate performance or all sale proceeds personally.

The 2021 yard transaction establishes a new majority owner, not a complete personal exit or retained stake for Mazanov. Investor and Operator remain plausible historical relationships but cannot be imported as current. Bank balance-sheet assets, customer deposits and liabilities are not personal wealth.

The title Founder repeated by yacht-owner aggregators is contradicted by the bank's 1994 origin and earlier ownership, and the yard had separate original founders. Criminal allegations found in searches were not needed for a durable profile and are not treated as adjudicated individual findings.

Exact-name LinkedIn results concern GC6/cybersecurity, AB InBev, Tinkoff backend engineering and other careers; none was authenticated as this banker. People-search aggregators were excluded.

No qualifying Wikipedia, Vimeo, Flickr, Trip Advisor or Zillow personal link was established. Current ICON company pages belong to a business with changed control, so no current company website is proposed. Forbes profile search was negative.

Only Banking and Ship repair satisfy active tag contracts on independent defining commercial activity. Personal yacht ownership is not tag evidence; generic Shipbuilding and Superyacht construction would add unnecessary overlap or imply stronger newbuild specialism than the post-acquisition record supports.
